visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a white ceramic bowl filled with clear broth, pork slices, shredded carrots, and green onions. A pair of wooden chopsticks picks up a bundle of ingredients. The background is a warm, wooden table with a white teapot. (2) Hands place pieces of dried kelp and two white broth bags into a copper pot of water on a portable gas stove. A hand pours dark liquid (soy sauce) and clear liquid (mirin) from small white cups into the pot. (3) A hand uses a black vegetable peeler to shred a large carrot into a metal bowl, creating thin orange strips quickly. (4) A hand uses a knife to scrape the outer skin of a long burdock root on a yellow cutting board, then uses a peeler to shred it into a metal strainer submerged in water. (5) A hand chops bright green celery stalks into small pieces on a yellow cutting board with a silver chef's knife. (6) A hand slices thin strips of raw pork belly on a black cutting board. (7) Pork slices are added to a pot of simmering water using a white bowl and chopsticks, then removed with a metal slotted spoon once blanched white. (8) Drained shredded carrots and burdock are combined in a large metal bowl with the blanched pork slices. Hands mix them thoroughly. (9) A hand slices brown shiitake mushrooms on a yellow cutting board and adds them to the boiling broth in the copper pot. (10) The mixed pork and vegetables are placed into a white striped bowl. Green onions, salt, and pepper are added. Hot broth and mushrooms are ladled over the ingredients. (11) A woman with short hair and glasses wearing a white shirt and green apron takes a bite of the soup using chopsticks, chewing and smiling at the camera in a kitchen setting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 非常清爽的日式. [Slogan]: 豬肉蔬菜湯. [Variety]: 宿便救星!. (2) [Subtitle]: 準備兩包無調味的高湯包跟昆布. (3) [Subtitle]: 加點醬油、味醂提鮮. (4) [Subtitle]: 滾了之後轉小火，煮12分鐘... (5) [Subtitle]: 紅蘿蔔先去皮再刨成絲. (6) [Subtitle]: 很快就有一大堆了. (7) [Subtitle]: 準備三分之一根牛蒡. (8) [Subtitle]: 先刮一下外皮. (9) [Subtitle]: 再用刨絲刀刨成絲. (10) [Subtitle]: 換一盆乾淨的水泡一下. (11) [Subtitle]: 這樣牛蒡絲就不會有土味了. (12) [Subtitle]: 再來切點芹菜. (13) [Subtitle]: 肉的部分我使用的是五花肉也可以換成梅花... (14) [Subtitle]: 先放到熱水裡川燙. (15) [Variety]: 不要煮滾. [Subtitle]: 直到反白就可以撈起來了. (16) [Subtitle]: 紅蘿蔔絲用水洗一下. (17) [Subtitle]: 把牛蒡絲瀝乾水分. (18) [Subtitle]: 把豬肉片放到盆子裡. (19) [Subtitle]: 紅蘿蔔絲跟牛蒡絲也放進來. (20) [Subtitle]: 充分的混合均勻. (21) [Subtitle]: 把高湯再次的煮沸. (22) [Subtitle]: 切一點香菇片. (23) [Subtitle]: 等湯滾了香菇片燙一下. (24) [Subtitle]: 準備一個碗... (25) [Subtitle]: 放入剛剛的豬肉牛蒡絲. (26) [Subtitle]: 一點芹菜增加香氣. (27) [Subtitle]: 一小撮鹽跟綜合胡椒. (28) [Subtitle]: 滾燙的高湯加進來... (29) [Subtitle]: 這樣蔬菜絲就會熟囉!. (30) [Subtitle]: 像這樣，超清爽又健康的. [Subtitle]: 日式豬肉蔬菜湯就完成啦~ ❤️. (31) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理請追蹤我IG. [Slogan]: 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房. [Slogan]: YouTube: @RosalinaKit. [Subtitle]: 希望大家有機會都可以試試看 ❤️.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, medium-tempo acoustic guitar melody in a major key. A female voice speaks with a friendly, professional tone, introducing the Japanese soup recipe. (2) A metallic click is heard as the stove is turned on, followed by the soft splash of broth bags hitting water. The narration continues smoothly over the BGM. (3) Rhythmic, crisp scraping and slicing sounds are introduced as vegetables are prepared. These transients are sharp and synchronized with the visual action. (4) The bubbling of boiling water is heard as pork is added, accompanied by the clinking of metal utensils. The speaker's volume remains consistent. (5) A series of rapid chopping sounds creates a percussive texture during the celery preparation phase. (6) The sound of liquid pouring and ladling broth is prominent towards the end, with the music swelling slightly in the final presentation. (7) The video concludes with the sound of a soft crunch and a satisfied vocal exhale as the creator tastes the soup, ending with a warm closing statement.
